_notes: The Drowning Floor boss and named-rare loot (2026-10-28). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3. Budget checked by audit() in tools/build_drowning_floor_content.py.

Yearmaw.name: Yearmaw's Drowned Fang
Yearmaw.flavor_text: It feeds once, on the day the cave fills, and then it waits out the year.

Yearmaw.name: Sumpblind Hauberk
Yearmaw.flavor_text: Nothing that lives in that water has needed eyes in a very long time.

Yearmaw.name: High-Water Greaves
Yearmaw.flavor_text: The mark is above your head on every pillar down here. Look up once and then do not.

Yearmaw.name: Yearmaw's Salt-Cured Hide
Yearmaw.flavor_text: A year in standing brine does to a skin what no tanner can.

Yearmaw.name: Sounding-Weight
Yearmaw.flavor_text: Lead, roped, and meant to be dropped. It throws well enough.
Yearmaw.label: Thrown (Str)

The Leavings.name: Wrackline Shiv
The Leavings.flavor_text: Cut from something the flood brought in. It is not bone and it is not wood.

The Leavings.name: Driftwood Bracers
The Leavings.flavor_text: Three years in the pile and the grain has gone hard as fired clay.

The Leavings.name: Pillar-Shadow Cowl
The Leavings.flavor_text: It denned where the roof came down, and the roof came down a long time ago.

The Leavings.name: Floodmark Pendant
The Leavings.flavor_text: Somebody wore this and did not get out. The cord outlasted them.

The Leavings.name: Floodwater Grapple-Fist
The Leavings.flavor_text: Barnacled. The barnacles have been left on deliberately.
The Leavings.label: Fist (Str)

Old Saltbed.name: Saltbed's Evaporite Staff
Old Saltbed.flavor_text: White all the way through, and it rings when you set it down.

Old Saltbed.name: Crusted Kodo Pauldrons
Old Saltbed.flavor_text: He came down out of the heat one dry season and the salt closed over him in that one.

Old Saltbed.name: Dry-Season Wraps
Old Saltbed.flavor_text: The Galak keep a calendar for this cave. It is the best thing about them.

Old Saltbed.name: Bedding-Plane Spaulders
Old Saltbed.flavor_text: One soft layer between two hard ones. The whole cave is that, and nothing else.

Old Saltbed.name: Drowning Floor Soundings
Old Saltbed.flavor_text: Depths, in a column that runs off the bottom of the page.
Old Saltbed.label: Tome (Spi)
